trial.cost_scope: Simulator wall is nested within phase walls. own_trial_wall is the sum of phases; never add these overlapping components. Historical R&D/preparation is bound once at suite level, without amortization.

agent_tokens.missing: Scripted solver used no model calls; engineering-session provider accounting is unavailable

engineer_time.missing: Not tracked; scripts do not measure engineer productivity

budget.boundary: Diagnostic phase only; executed prefixes reserve additional slots. Slots include attempts interrupted before completion. Confirmation is a separately equal obligation.

costs.scope: Rollout, reset and trace-write components; nested within phase/command walls, never added to them

diagnosis_record.interpretation: A diagnostic proposal is not a confirmed correction; no acceptance is claimed before fresh final confirmation

ordinary_checks.scope: ordinary descriptive checks; final acceptance belongs to Fable
